goal: Implement the first CP-08 functional slice: one read-only non-focusable health summary from the injected TuiDataPort.health contract
direct_dependencies: I32 frozen CP-08 read-only status scope
tests_required: compile runtime and targeted runtime test
health is read exactly once from the injected port
health summary maps error/warning/ok counts to ROT/GELB/GRÜN semantics
health status is non-focusable and category focus remains unchanged
manual category refresh does not re-read health
existing category-entry-field, empty-state and refresh regressions
guard that recent_events remains outside this slice
tests_explicitly_not_run: web/browser regression because CP-07H is untouched
repository/domain regression because frozen core is untouched
screenshot because I33 is not a fifth-iteration milestone and no concrete layout defect is known
risks: health data is a startup snapshot only; no polling or refresh of health is authorized

expected_side_effects: one read-only status line is added to the Textual shell
existing navigation remains the only focusable interaction path
